summary: Completed testing of new AI-powered Import module for Kuxtal Travels CRM. Import tab renders correctly with Sparkles icon, supported format badges (PDF, Imagenes, Word, Excel), Google Drive URL input, and Procesar button. Backend endpoint POST /api/packages/import-from-drive validates inputs correctly. All existing functionality preserved.
passed_tests: Backend API tests (31/31 passed - 26 existing + 5 new import tests)
Admin login -> admin dashboard loads correctly
Import tab visible in admin dashboard (between Dashboard and Analytics)
Import tab shows header with Sparkles icon
Import tab shows supported format badges (PDF, Imagenes, Word, Excel)
Google Drive URL input field exists with data-testid='import-drive-url'
Procesar button disabled when URL is empty (correct validation)
POST /api/packages/import-from-drive requires admin auth (401 without token)
POST /api/packages/import-from-drive returns 400 for invalid URL format

Various GDrive URL formats recognized (file/d/, open?id=, uc?id=)
All admin tabs still work (Dashboard, Import, Analytics, Members, Packages, Commerce, Quotations)
Member dashboard still works correctly (Family, Benefits tabs tested)
Package creation via normal form still works
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 tested new AI Import module. Import tab added between Dashboard and Analytics in AdminDashboard.js. AdminImport.js component handles Google Drive URL input, AI extraction via Gemini 2.5 Flash, and pre-filled form for review. Backend endpoint /api/packages/import-from-drive downloads GDrive file, detects type (PDF/Word/Excel/Image), extracts text, sends to Gemini AI, returns structured JSON. Note: Cannot test with real GDrive files in test environment - only validation tests possible. Gemini AI integration uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from backend/.env via emergentintegrations library.
